name: catalog
title: Catalog
summary: What a product is: categories, attributes, brands, products, variants, and the review workflow that decides whether a product may be sold. How a seller sells it (price, stock, condition) belongs to offers.
owns: Category tree, category attributes and image standards
Shared product content: title, description, key features, specs, included items, images, identifiers
Variants (colour, size, capacity) and their identifiers
Product review workflow: Draft, Submitted, Changes requested, Approved, Rejected
Publication: Active, Hidden, Suspended (always with a reason)
Correction suggestions to shared content and duplicate merges
Frozen product snapshots for order items
Brand status, seller authorization (who can sell) and seller brand requests
Listing counts read model (offers, in-stock products) for admin lists, category and brand counts
notOwns: Price, condition, stock, dispatch and return terms: offers and inventory
Search ranking and suggestions: search (reads catalog events)

publicApi.desc: Read shared product content

publicApi.name: isPurchasable

publicApi.name: getBrandBySlug

publicApi.name: getProductForSeller
publicApi.signature: (sellerId: uuid, productId: uuid) => { product: ProductAdmin, ownsSubmission: bool } | null

Review log, missing fields and the submission are returned only when ownsSubmission is true (null otherwise); reviewState is returned for every resolved product (always approved when the seller did not submit it). Null (NOT_FOUND) only for another seller's unapproved product, or a hidden or suspended product the seller has no offer on.

filterable.desc: Shown as a category filter in the store

id.desc: An attribute of this category to keep (its id stays, so product values keep pointing at it); omitted for a new attribute

options.desc: The values to choose from (kind enum)

filterable.desc: Shown as a category filter in the store

status.desc: Store lists only show active brands; getBrands and admin reads return any status

weightGrams.desc: Shipping weight of one unit in its retail packaging (parcel data for shipping quotes and labels)

listPrice.desc: Manufacturer list price (MSRP) set by Marketly staff; sellers cannot set it. Offers may show it as a reference price

purchasable.desc: Approved and active (same answer as isPurchasable)

mergedIntoId.desc: Set when this product was merged into another; read the kept product instead

names.desc: Root first, ending with the category itself, e.g. ["Electronics", "Audio", "Headphones"]

ids.desc: Category ids in the same order

listPrice.desc: Staff only. Send null to clear

ref.desc: Human product reference PRD-NNNNN, shown on duplicates, merges and admin lists

noGtin.desc: Submitter confirmed the product has no GTIN (custom-made or private label); variants may then have no gtin and the reviewer may ask for proof

listedAt.desc: When the product was first approved and listed (New listing / Listed on …)

isNewListing.desc: Store product detail (GET /api/store/catalog/products/{id}) only: listed within search.newArrivalsWindowDays, the same rule as the New listing badge on search cards; null elsewhere

bestSellerRank.desc: Store product detail only: best-seller rank in its category from search (search.bestSellerRanks), e.g. #3 in Headphones; null without a rank, when search is off, and elsewhere

checks.desc: Automated checks on the latest submission (staff only)

requestedBrand.desc: Brand the submitter asked to add (no brandId yet); becomes an under_review brand on submit

contentScore.desc: 0–100 completeness and quality score (required attributes, images against the category standard, description length, identifiers, key features); recomputed on every save

duplicateSuspected.desc: Latest submission has a duplicate check with warn or fail that was not dismissed

offerNote.desc: Offer-state note when some offers are not live, e.g. Gadget Grove offer paused · 3 other offers live

reviewDraft.desc: The calling reviewer's unsent decision on the open submission (staff only)

imagesToRecrop.desc: Images of the product and its variants that no longer have the product image spec's aspect ratio (media.productImage changed): show "Re-crop images". Not blocking: the product stays live and the store shows them cover-cropped. Empty when none

reason.desc: Decision reason, or the submitter's note to the reviewer on submitted entries

noGtin.desc: Confirm the product has no GTIN; otherwise every variant needs a gtin before submission

requestedBrand.desc: Brand not listed: request it instead of brandId. It is reviewed with the product

weightGrams.desc: Packaged weight of one unit; reviewed with the product

listPrice.desc: Accepted only on admin endpoints (Official Store drafts); refused with VALIDATION_FAILED from sellers

merges.desc: Records merged into the kept product: duplicate products and open submissions

matchQuality.desc: Exact model match; same model with different box contents (e.g. HA-ANC700-TB); a close but different model; or a title-only hit

myOffers.desc: The caller's own offers on this product ("You sell Midnight black (New, Used – Good)")

categoryId.desc: The product's category at purchase (finance category fee rates)

imageId.desc: Media asset id of the main image (variant image first, else product image), so orders can resolve it later with media.refs even if the product changes

image.desc: The same image as a MediaRef at snapshot time

kind.desc: new product, change to an approved product's content, or submitted again after changes were requested

reviewDeadline.desc: Internal review target that orders the queue (setting reviewTargetBusinessDays)

pausedAt.desc: Set while a restriction or suspension of the seller pauses the review: the submission is left out of the review queue until the seller is reinstated

assignee.desc: Reviewer who picked it up (staff only)

note.desc: Submitter's note to the reviewer, e.g. what changed on resubmission

message.desc: e.g. 2 possible duplicates with the same model number

dismissal.desc: Set when a reviewer marked the finding not applicable (e.g. Not a duplicate)

label.desc: e.g. Matched product, Claim in description, Image 3

dismissedAt.desc: Duplicate candidates: when a reviewer marked this matched product not a duplicate (check_dismissals)

text.desc: e.g. Minimum 1000 × 1000 px, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB

severity.desc: Blocking fails the image_standard check; warning is advisory

check.desc: Machine-checkable parameters passed to media.checkImage, e.g. { "minWidth": 1000 }. aspectRatios are ignored for product photos: the product image spec's ratio (media.productImage) applies to every category

filledCount.desc: Products in the category (approved or in review) with a value for this attribute

productCount.desc: Products in the category the count is out of

status.desc: Only active brands show in the store and can be chosen for new submissions; under_review covers seller brand requests and brands flagged by Trust and Risk

flagNote.desc: e.g. Counterfeit report CS-261004-0377 with Trust and Risk

sellingPolicy.desc: Who can sell: open to all sellers, sellers on the authorized list, or the Official Store only. Shown as "Brand not verified" while status is under_review

authorizedSellerIds.desc: Sellers on the authorized list (staff-added or from an approved brand-affiliation claim)

sellerCount.desc: Distinct sellers (Official Store counts as one) with an eligible offer on the brand

pageLive.desc: Active with at least one in-stock product, so the store brand page is reachable

requestedBy.desc: Set when a seller requested the brand with a product submission

productId.desc: Set when requested with a product submission

changeRequestId.desc: Set when added from an approved sellers brand_request change request

note.desc: e.g. how the seller sources the brand

matchedProductId.desc: The duplicate candidate that was dismissed (others stay open)

asNewVariant.desc: Add the record as a new variation of the kept product with these options, e.g. { "Color": "Lavender", "Switch": "Kestrel Brown" }

intoVariantId.desc: Merge into this existing variation of the kept product. Omit both to map variants by matching options

redirectFrom.desc: Old product slug that now redirects

offersOnSaleAfter.desc: Eligible offers after the merge (paused offers stay paused)

pastOrders.desc: Order items (open and past) on the merged records, from orders.countOrderItemsForProducts; they keep their purchase snapshots. Null only when orders is disabled

notes.desc: What carries over, e.g. Gadget Grove offer moves to Gray and stays paused while the seller is restricted; old URLs, ads and coupons now point to the kept product

inReview.desc: Open submissions in the review queue

activeOffers.desc: Eligible offers that stop showing (become ineligible) until the product is active again

cartsAffected.desc: Carts holding these offers; shoppers see the item as unavailable. Null when cart is disabled

openOrders.desc: Open order items for the product; they continue and keep their purchase snapshots. From orders.countOrderItemsForProducts; null only when orders is disabled

openReturns.desc: Open returns; they continue. From returns.countOpenReturnsForProducts; null only when returns is disabled

openCases.desc: Open customer cases; they continue. From support.countOpenCasesForProducts; null only when support is disabled

stateMachines.name: Product review
stateMachines.notes: Submit is blocked until required information is present (title, brand, category, description of 40+ characters, one image, one variant, required category attributes). Reopen is used after an accepted correction that changes what the product is. Withdraw takes a seller's first submission (a product never listed) back to draft.

stateMachines.name: Publication
stateMachines.notes: Independent of review. Every change records a reason. Suspending a product does not remove other sellers' valid offers from past orders.

stateMachines.name: Brand status
stateMachines.notes: Staff-created brands start active; seller-requested brands start under_review. Every change records a reason. Blocking stops new submissions and new offers on the brand; existing products are hidden or suspended separately through publication.

endpoints.summary: Search the catalog before adding a product
endpoints.desc: Matches on GTIN, model number and title so sellers attach offers to the exact existing product. Each match states matchQuality (exact, same model with a different bundle, different model, title only), the model number, category path, in-the-box list, offer count and lowest price, and the caller's own offers on it (offers.listOwnOffersForProduct). When nothing matches exactly, close different_model matches are still returned so the screen can warn against them. Only approved, active products are matched.

The optional note is stored on the submission and in the review log for the reviewer. A requestedBrand is created as an under_review brand linked to this submission (event catalog.brand.requested).

endpoints.desc: Only drafts and products with changes requested that were never listed and have no open submission (withdraw it first). The product, its variants and review history are removed and its files are released.

Attributes (own and inherited) and image standards for a category (drives the submission form)

endpoints.summary: Product with review history and duplicate candidates
Mark an automated check finding as not applicable (e.g. Not a duplicate)
endpoints.desc: Applies to the latest submission's check of that kind. For duplicate checks, matchedProductId dismisses one candidate; omit it to dismiss all. Recorded in the review log; the product leaves Duplicates suspected when no duplicate finding is open.

endpoints.summary: Undo a dismissed check finding
endpoints.desc: Opens the finding again on the latest submission. For duplicate checks, matchedProductId restores one dismissed candidate; omit it to restore all. Recorded in the review log; a duplicate finding puts the product back in Duplicates suspected.

endpoints.summary: Save the reviewer's unsent decision
endpoints.desc: Keeps decision, reason and field comments for the open submission per reviewer (ProductAdmin.reviewDraft). Cleared when approve, request-changes or reject is sent.

Edit an Official Store draft
Submit an Official Store product (same standard as sellers)
Approve a submission
endpoints.desc: Official Store products (no seller) need a second person: whoever created, edited or sent the product for review since its last decision cannot approve it (SAME_REVIEWER). A failed brand_authorization check blocks approval (BRAND_NOT_AUTHORIZED); the other submission checks stay advisory.
A product whose brand is under review (seller brand request) cannot be approved until the brand is activated (POST /brands/{id}/status).

endpoints.desc: Call GET /products/{id}/publication-impact first; the confirmation shows its effects.

endpoints.summary: What hiding or suspending the product would do
endpoints.desc: Preview shown before setPublication and bulk hide or suspend (plan ch. 18: catalog removal explains its effects on open orders and customer cases): offers that stop showing and their sellers (offers.listActiveOffersForProduct), carts holding them (cart.countOfferInCarts), and open orders (orders.countOrderItemsForProducts), returns (returns.countOpenReturnsForProducts) and cases (support.countOpenCasesForProducts) that continue unchanged with their purchase snapshots. Counts from modules that are disabled are null.

endpoints.summary: Merge duplicates and submissions into the product to keep
endpoints.desc: Each merges[] record either becomes a new variation (asNewVariant), joins an existing variation (intoVariantId) or is mapped by matching options. Offers, reviews and questions move to the kept product; past orders keep their snapshots; merged products redirect; a merged open submission is decided as merged. Publishes catalog.product.merged once per record. Preview with POST /products/merge/preview.

consumes.name: media.product_images.recrop_changed
consumes.does: Products and variants using the images (usages product_image and variant_image): recrop true adds them to the product's images to re-crop (imagesToRecrop; the Admin catalog's missing-content tab lists the product) and publishes catalog.images.recrop_needed per seller; recrop false removes them. Products stay live

consumes.name: access.approval.decided
consumes.does: Finish a publication override that needed approval (approved: apply it; otherwise drop the pending override)

consumes.name: sellers.seller.restricted
consumes.does: When the restriction covers product submissions (optionally scoped to categories), block new drafts and submissions from that seller in scope and pause its open submissions in the review queue

consumes.name: sellers.seller.suspended
consumes.does: Pause the seller's open submissions in the review queue

consumes.name: sellers.seller.reinstated
consumes.does: Return paused submissions to the review queue

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.recorded
consumes.does: action suspend_product: suspend the named products (publication suspended, reason from the enforcement); the review-log entry keeps enforcementId and trustReportId and catalog.product.publication_changed carries both

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.reversed
consumes.does: action suspend_product: reactivate each target product whose current suspension came from that enforcement (found by the enforcementId on its publication_changed review-log entry). Products suspended again since, or merged, are left alone. No publication-override approval is asked: the reversal was already approved in trust. Logs the reversal reason and publishes catalog.product.publication_changed (suspended → active, trustEnforcementId). Other actions are ignored

consumes.name: offers.offer.created
consumes.does: Add the offer to offer_index and refresh listing_stats for the product

consumes.name: offers.offer.status_changed
consumes.does: Update offer eligibility in offer_index and refresh listing_stats (offerNote names paused offers)

consumes.name: offers.offer.price_changed
consumes.does: Update the offer price in offer_index and the product best price

consumes.name: inventory.stock.changed
consumes.does: Update in_stock for the offer in offer_index and refresh listing_stats

consumes.name: sellers.change_request.decided
consumes.does: kind brand_request and approved: create the brand as active from brandRequest (selling policy open: every approved seller may list it and the requesting seller gets no exclusive authorization; requestedBy records the seller and the change request), or activate a brand with the same name that is still under_review; publishes catalog.brand.changed. Rejected requests and other kinds are ignored

jobs.name: catalog.refresh-counts
jobs.does: Fill offer_index prices still missing (offers.getOffers: offers indexed before offers.offer.created carried the price), then roll listing_stats up into category_stats (with subcategories) and brand_stats (overall and per top-level category)

settings.desc: Internal target from submission to review decision; sets each submission's review deadline (queue order) and the expected review date shown to the submitter

notes: Official Store products follow the same review standard as seller products (plan ch. 2).
Variants are replaced as a set while a product is a draft; after approval, variant changes go through corrections so existing offers keep their variant ids.

Automated submission checks (plan ch. 8: review for duplicates, misleading claims, poor imagery and incorrect categories) run when a product is submitted and are stored per submission in submission_checks: duplicate (title, brand, model number, GTIN and image similarity against existing products), image_standard (media.checkImage against the category image_standards), category_fit (attributes and title against the chosen category), prohibited_claim (medical, safety and superlative claims in title, features and description), brand_authorization (protected brands need an approved brand claim), restricted_item (restricted categories and keywords) and identifier (GTIN format and reuse). Results are pass, warn or fail with evidence; they are shown to the reviewer in the review queue and never approve or reject on their own. Fail results are listed to the submitter only through the reviewer's request-changes reasons.

Each submit creates a submissions row (SUB-YYMMDD-NNNN): kind new for a first submission, resubmitted after changes were requested, content_change when an approved product is reopened. Draft saves update last_saved_at and last_saved_by; the review queue is ordered by review_due_at.

Review dates: review_due_at (submitted + reviewTargetBusinessDays) and expected_review_by (one business day later) count business days on the settings business calendar (settings.businessCalendar: opening days and closures in the market time zone); while settings is off, Monday to Friday in UTC.

Paused submissions: sellers.seller.restricted (product submissions) and sellers.seller.suspended set paused_at on the seller's open submissions (in the restricted categories) and the review queue leaves them out; sellers.seller.reinstated clears paused_at on those no remaining restriction covers. A paused submission keeps its review_due_at, so it returns to its original place in the queue.
Product references: every product gets ref PRD-NNNNN at creation; it is shown on duplicates, merges and admin lists and accepted by admin search.

Content score (0–100) is recomputed on every save from required attributes filled, images meeting the category standard, description length, key features and identifiers; missing[] lists what lowers it.

Listing counts: catalog keeps offer_index from offers and inventory events (offers.getOfferStats on rebuild) so admin lists, CatalogMatch, category and brand counts need no per-row calls to offers. Counts may lag by the job interval.

Brand requests: a seller who cannot find a brand sends requestedBrand with the product. On submit the brand is created with status under_review and requestedBy; the reviewer activates or blocks it (POST /brands/{id}/status) before deciding the product. Brand affiliation claims shown on storefronts stay in sellers (public claims). A seller can also request a brand without a product (sellers POST /brand-requests, a brand_request change request reviewed in sellers with its evidence). Both paths end in the same catalog state, an active brand with requestedBy set: on sellers.change_request.decided (approved) catalog creates the brand as active, or activates a same-name brand that is still under_review from a product submission, so the product waiting on it can then be decided. catalog does not review that request a second time.
Seller offer creation: myProduct / getProductForSeller resolves any approved, active product so seller/offer can show the read-only product card before the seller has an offer on it.

Impact and merge previews count open and past order items, open returns and open cases in-process (orders.countOrderItemsForProducts, returns.countOpenReturnsForProducts, support.countOpenCasesForProducts). Those modules depend on catalog, so catalog lists them only as optional dependencies resolved at call time; a disabled module leaves its count null.

Parcel data and list price live on the variant (decision O1/O2): sellers may enter weight and packaged dimensions with the submission; Marketly staff set or correct them on any product with PATCH /products/{id}/variants/{variantId}. listPrice (MSRP) is a staff-only field. Offers, shipping, cart and checkout read them with getParcels / getVariants and fall back to their own default parcel when weightGrams is null.

Media usages: every uploaded file catalog keeps is attached with media.attach so the media orphan sweep never deletes it: product_image / product_video / variant_image, brand_logo, brand_banner (brand banners), category_image (category tiles) and correction_evidence (correction suggestion evidence).
Accepted corrections are logged as correction_accepted review-log entries and shown in the product history like every other action.

approvalActions.desc: Reactivate a product suspended after a trust report, or override another team's publication decision
approvalActions.approvers: Catalog Manager with Trust and Risk Manager (example)

BRAND_NOT_AUTHORIZED.meaning: The brand does not let this seller sell it (blocked, official_only or not on the authorized list): approving the submission or the offer is refused

SAME_REVIEWER.meaning: The person who created, edited or submitted an Official Store product cannot approve it.

BRAND_NOT_ACTIVE.meaning: The product's brand is under review or blocked; decide the brand first

DATASET_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: reports refused the export dataset: it is not in the export registry or catalog exports are switched off (raised by reports.requestExport)
